answer: An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch thus pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Because the pulse solution is checked at the forge gate and logged, the cipher audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 23 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. Bonded capital sits idle for 2 days. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
